design.procedure: draw a probe of q labelled keys from the pool, decide mix vs exploit inside the probe at the proportionally scaled budget, then apply that decision to the full pool's top 20

coin_flip_check: the probe's hit rate matches a 50/50 coin flip between the two fixed strategies to within 0.6 pp, so its apparent gain over always-exploit is the base-rate advantage of the mix, not skill
why_the_fixed_threshold_did_better: the fixed threshold was learned from 120 (pool x split) observations, whereas a 500-key probe supplies 500 labels from one pool
promotion_status: NOT satisfied and now without a known route: the fixed threshold does not transfer (C38) and in-place re-estimation is at chance (C39)
